title: Every physical event with a sufficient cause has a sufficient physical cause

statements.text: The central motivation for epiphenomenalism is the premise that whenever a physical event has a sufficient cause, it has a sufficient physical cause. If a mental event is something other than a physical event, its making any causal contribution of its own in the physical world would require a violation of physical law, as Descartes's nonphysical nudges to the pineal gland would.

sources.quote: The central motivation for epiphenomenalism lies in the premise that whenever there is a sufficient cause of a physical event, there is a sufficient physical cause of that event.
